# Card events

## CARD\_ADDED { #event-6 }

```aa2m
on CARD_ADDED
```

When a card (including this card) is added to a class, after the CARD\_INTIALIZED event is executed

**Example**

```aa2m
trigger "Example" {
  on CARD_ADDED;
}
```

Native name: Card Added to Class (Card). ID: `event-6`

## CARD\_DESTROYED { #event-3 }

```aa2m
on CARD_DESTROYED
```

Before the AAU Card data will be unloaded

**Example**

```aa2m
trigger "Example" {
  on CARD_DESTROYED;
}
```

Native name: Card Destroyed (Card). ID: `event-3`

## CARD\_INITIALIZED { #event-2 }

```aa2m
on CARD_INITIALIZED
```

After the AAU Card data was successfully loaded, either because a class containing this card was loaded, or because this card was added to the class roster

**Example**

```aa2m
trigger "Example" {
  on CARD_INITIALIZED;
}
```

Native name: Card Initialized (Card). ID: `event-2`
